 Show me! Save Share X (twitter.com) Facebook Mail Early voting for this year’s midterm is at a record high in Minnesota . The secretary of state reported more than 886,000 ballots cast through Sunday; it could reach 1 million by the end of Monday.
 Secretary of State Steve Simon is expected to speak on the numbers later Monday.
